items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I think it was Frenchie -- came over from Moe Gale's office. He worked for a year with me.

ctx.x: Who was Louie's road manager, by the way?
He came over from Glaser. I think it was Frenchie -- came over from Moe Gale's office. He worked for a year with me.
How about Lionel, who was his road manager?
